propositions: Recursive snapshot teardown using pathlib.Path.rglob across tmp_path enters mutable tracker lock directories that disappear concurrently during walk, causing FileNotFoundError on Python 3.11 but not 3.12

Python 3.11 pathlib caches parent directory entries and does not suppress FileNotFoundError when a cached child directory vanishes before descent, while Python 3.12 delegates to walk with error tolerance

Canonical store lock lifecycle intentionally creates and removes .ticket-write.lock.d directories, racing with fixture teardown that traverses the entire tmp_path tree including unrelated tracker subdirectories
Repair must retain recursive exact-root .rebar/run_snapshots discovery, tolerate only FileNotFoundError for concurrently vanished entries, and switch from Path.rglob to os.walk with onerror handler

Ambient Path() factory calls in test teardown code raise NotImplementedError on Python 3.11 when os.name is monkeypatched to 'nt' before fixture teardown, requiring type preservation through snapshot cleanup
